dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (cobc) as stated in the Tectonics comment; uses USAGE IS COMPUTATIONAL, USAGE IS INDEX, USAGE IS DISPLAY, OCCURS, REDEFINES, EVALUATE TRUE ALSO TRUE — all standard COBOL-85 features

purpose.domain_detail: French residential electricity billing analysis — EDF Tempo tariff (Rouge/Blanc/Bleu day classification with HP/HC peak hours)
purpose.summary: Reads a CSV file of hourly electricity consumption data (RFC3339 timestamps and Wh values), classifies each hour into one of 7 Tempo tariff buckets (Base, Rouge HP/HC, Blanc HP/HC, Bleu HP/HC), accumulates totals, then reports costs and savings compared to the flat Base tariff for 2022 and 2023 French EDF tariff rates.

notable_features: EVALUATE TRUE ALSO TRUE with 88-level condition names
USAGE IS COMPUTATIONAL on large data structures
REDEFINES used for both table overlay and numeric overlay (CTotalWh/CTotalKWh)
OCCURS on both data and cost tables
88-level conditions for day colour (JourRouge/JourBlanc/JourBleu) and peak hour (IsHP)
No COPY, no CALL, no EXEC SQL/CICS
verdict.notes: Program is a personal utility for analysing French EDF Tempo electricity tariff billing. The SetCouleurJour paragraph hardcodes specific calendar days for 2022 only, so it is not fully general but is functionally complete for its stated purpose. Comments at the end are in French listing the Jours Rouges/Blancs. No truncation issues observed.
